title: calc_ut Delta T should use effective ephemeris, not configured source
description:
calc_ut() computes Delta T via calc_deltat(jd_ut, &self.config), which uses the configured EphemerisSource for tidal acceleration selection. But calc() forces Moshier via plaus_iflag regardless of configured source. If a caller sets EphemerisSource::Jpl, calc_ut uses JPL tidal acceleration for the UT→TT conversion while the position is computed with Moshier — a silent inconsistency.

Currently bounded: only Moshier is supported and config defaults to Moshier. But this will bite when file backends are added.

Fix options:
1. calc_ut passes the effective (post-plaus_iflag) ephemeris to calc_deltat
2. calc_deltat accepts effective flags instead of full config
3. Reject non-Moshier configs at Ephemeris::new() until file backends exist

Also: add calc_ut golden test cases against swe_calc_ut."
root_cause: plaus_iflag silently forces MOSEPH regardless of configured EphemerisSource, but calc_ut computes Delta T using the configured source's tidal acceleration. The mismatch means a non-Moshier config would use one model for UT→TT and another for position computation.
